title: CaptureManifest
description: manifest.json of a capture bundle, schema_version 1 (docs/capture-bundle.md). Written by the mapper app's TypeScript side. There is no contributor_id: the server takes it from the upload's authentication. Unknown fields are rejected; adding one is a schema_version bump. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: frame_count and keyframe_count match poses.jsonl, faces_blurred and screens_blurred match privacy/blur.jsonl, files lists every other file in the bundle exactly once with matching byte count and SHA-256, depth_size is [256, 192], image_size is landscape with the same aspect ratio and at most maxImagePixels pixels, and the keyframe JPEGs and depth PNGs have these sizes.

schema_version.description: Version of the capture bundle format.

capture_id.description: UUID generated on the phone; becomes captures.id and names the bundle directory, capture-<capture_id>/.

device_model.description: Hardware identifier of the phone, for example iPhone18,2.

os_version.description: Operating system and version, for example iOS 26.6.1. Kept with every segment's drift: iOS 26.4 to 26.6.0 had a LiDAR world-tracking drift regression.

session_started_at.description: Wall-clock time at t = 0. Earlier than started_at when one ARKit session spans consecutive segments.

started_at.description: Wall-clock time when the segment started.

ended_at.description: Wall-clock time when the segment ended.

keyframe_count.description: Number of lines in poses.jsonl with keyframe true.

image_size.description: [w, h] of the keyframe JPEGs, in the sensor's native landscape orientation.

depth_size.description: [w, h] of the depth and confidence PNGs: always [256, 192], the size of ARKit's scene depth. The validator checks this.

drift_m.description: Metres between where the end anchor was expected and where the scan put it, or null when it can't be computed (the end anchor has no position in this session's frame).

files.description: Every file in the bundle except manifest.json. At most 20000, the validator's maxEntries.

privacy.title: ManifestPrivacy
privacy.description: How keyframes were blurred on the phone before they were written.

blur_method.description: How boxes were obscured: solid fill, or pixelation with the cell size (16 px or larger), for example "pixelate, 16 px cells, padded box".

faces_blurred.description: Number of face boxes across all keyframes in privacy/blur.jsonl.

screens_blurred.description: Number of screen boxes across all keyframes in privacy/blur.jsonl.

detectorVersions.title: DetectorVersions
detectorVersions.description: The detector and its revision or model version for each box kind in privacy/blur.jsonl.

face.description: Face detector, for example VNDetectFaceRectanglesRequest with the revision in use.

person_head.description: Person detector whose head regions are blurred, for example VNDetectHumanRectanglesRequest with the revision in use.

file.title: ManifestFile
file.description: One bundle file, with its size and digest.
